rationale: Both Sunil and Anthony bring full-stack web development expertise with complementary depths: Sunil is an early-career engineer actively building across AI, blockchain, and web with TypeScript and Python, while Anthony is a senior engineer at Mindbody with deep full-stack web systems experience and a track record mentoring engineers. Anthony's emphasis on automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and technical leadership could directly strengthen Sunil's project quality and career development, while Sunil's blockchain and AI interests offer Anthony exposure to emerging domains beyond his current healthcare-SaaS focus.
intro_message: Sunil Kumar Chavhan, meet Anthony Braun — you both share full-stack web development as a core strength, and Anthony's mentoring experience and systems expertise could help level up your early-career work while your blockchain and AI projects might spark his interest in new domains.
